rules.title: RSO/JCO Relocation Assistance Amounts (Chart A)
rules.requirement: Relocation assistance under the RSO or JCO is $11,000 for an eligible tenant with less than 3 years of tenancy, or $14,400 with 3 or more years or low income. For a qualified tenant it is $23,150 or $27,400. Assistance is paid per unit, not per tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants displaced from units subject to the RSO or JCO. The amount depends on qualified or eligible status, length of tenancy and income.
rules.exemptions: Single family dwellings that are not lower income may be entitled to one month's equivalent of rent instead, depending on various factors.

rules.title: JCO Relocation for Single Family Dwellings Owned by Natural Persons
rules.requirement: This applies to a single-family dwelling subject to the JCO whose owner is a natural person owning no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City. Relocation is one month's rent that was in effect when the landlord served the written termination notice, paid as money or as a credit.
rules.key_value: one month’s rent that was in effect when the landlord served the written notice to terminate the tenancy
rules.coverage_text: Single-family dwellings subject to the JCO owned by a natural person, including through a trust or legal entity controlled by that person, who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.quoted_span: The Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 151.30(E) shall not apply.
rules.interaction_text: The Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 151.30(E) shall not apply.

rules.title: Relocation Assistance Payment Timing and Escrow
rules.requirement: If a unit has one tenant, that tenant receives the entire payment; if two or more tenants occupy a unit, each receives an equal pro rata share. Payments must be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction, or placed in an escrow account within that 15-day period; escrow payments must be made within three (3) working days of a request.
rules.key_value: within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction
rules.coverage_text: Landlords owing relocation assistance under the City Ordinances.
rules.penalty: In an action by the landlord to recover possession, the tenant may raise as an affirmative defense the landlord's failure to provide relocation assistance; the tenant may also file a complaint with LAHD or seek a private right of action.
rules.quoted_span: The monies must be placed in the escrow account within the required 15-day period.

rules.title: Relocation Offset for Accumulated Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may offset the tenant's accumulated rent against any relocation assistance. This does not apply when the assistance is owed because a governmental agency order to vacate or comply, issued for an unpermitted dwelling, requires termination of the tenancy.
rules.exemptions: No offset when the relocation assistance is owed because a termination of tenancy is required by a governmental agency order to vacate or comply issued for an unpermitted dwelling.
